headword: {二段階認証|にだんかいにんしょう}
reading: にだんかいにんしょう

definitions.explanation: a security process requiring two different forms of identification to access an account, typically a password plus a code sent to a phone

SECURITY TERM:
{二段階認証|にだんかいにんしょう} adds an extra layer of security beyond just a password.
